Name: Frontier Farm WorldMap area Fix
Author: ShenXL192168
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]"This version of the Frontier Farm seems to have an issue with area misalignment."[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51934/51934-1788874722-1352341106.png[/img][/b][/size]
[size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51934/51934-1788874770-344859063.png[/img][/b][/size]
The mod provides a fix for the area misalignment on the map for the Border Farm and Grandpa's Cottage.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51934/51934-1788887829-1414302927.png[/img]




[s][b]It is worth noting that, in the Chinese environment, the Secret Forest is incorrectly displayed on the map as "Secret Woods." This mod also fixes that incidentally. [font=Arial][color=#ff0000]"Due to my limited proficiency, this may cause the location labels for the Secret Forest and Grandpa's Cottage on the map to be permanently displayed in Chinese. Users of other languages should replace the Chinese characters with their own language in the        [/color][color=#0000ff] content.json [/color][color=#ff0000]    [/color][/font][/b][b][color=#ff0000] file manually.[/color]"[/b][/s][b]Now supports i18n.[/b]

[s]值得说明的是，发现在中文环境下，秘密森林在地图上会错误的显示为秘密 树林，本模组顺便修复了一下。 因本人水平较低，这可能会导致地图显示上秘密森林的位置和爷爷的小屋固定显示为中文，请其他语言的用户自行在content.json文件中将中文字符替换为自己使用的语言[/s]。支持i18格式。

Fully compatible with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29049]Remapping - Minimap Project at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url] [/b]. Both mods will work together without conflicts.

兼容 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29049]Remapping - Minimap Project at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url]。二者会同时生效

Manifest.Name: Frontier Farm WorldMap Safe Fix
Manifest.Description: Fixes Frontier Farm WorldMap hover areas, removes SVE's obsolete Grandpa's Shed hotspot, preserves the corrected shed position, and supports localization.
Manifest.Author: ShenXL192168
